description: Focused ScanTailor two-dimensional refinement derived from the 480-set characterization. Boundary search margin is overwhelmingly dominant (eta-squared 0.7995), while projection smoothing has low standalone influence but a strong incremental interaction with boundary margin. The search therefore concentrates 54 Cartesian points around the 0.075 / 0.003 winning basin: boundary margin spans 0.065-0.085 in 0.0025 steps and projection smoothing spans 0.002-0.0045 in 0.0005 steps. Illumination sigma, ink quantile, content close, and minimum page area are pinned to the current winning values so grid budget is not spent re-exploring characterized low/zombie dimensions. The detector's true default profile remains separately preserved as the mandatory baseline reference.
